clue.text: Casual wear or formal wear in the West Country?

indicators.note: the formal wear is placed in the city, so the city name comes before it

parts.note: Bath is a spa city in the West Country, the south-west of England
a robe is a formal ceremonial gown, as worn by judges or academics

explanation.surface: Asks whether a dressing-gown counts as smart dress down in the south-west of England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' reads as location: ROBE found in BATH, so BATH comes first in the answer. The West Country is south-west England, where the city of Bath stands.
explanation.definitionFit: A towelling gown worn after bathing is relaxed, informal clothing.

clue.text: Badly-behaved lad occupying worker and official

indicators.note: occupying means the scrambled lad sits inside the worker

parts.note: a worker is a bee, the classic crossword sense of a worker insect

indicators.note: badly-behaved suggests the letters of lad are put out of order

explanation.surface: A naughty boy gets in the way of a labourer and an officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Badly-behaved' is the anagram signal for the lad, and 'occupying' puts the result inside the worker insect.
explanation.definitionFit: A beadle is a minor parish or ceremonial officer, so an official.

clue.text: Right sort of power in the northerly part of Greece

parts.note: AC, alternating current, is a kind of electrical power

explanation.surface: A discussion of electrical supply in the north of the Greek mainland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the' looks like a link word joining the definition, but it is the container that 'in' opens.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrace is the historic region forming the north-eastern corner of mainland Greece.

clue.text: Inspire to get about — in the swim

indicators.note: in places the word for about inside the word for swim

parts.note: to bathe is to swim in the sea or a pool
re is Latin-derived for about or concerning, as in business letters

explanation.surface: Encouraging someone to go out and join in the fashionable set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the swim' looks like the idiom for being fashionable, but it splits into the container signal 'in' and the leaf 'swim'.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspire in its literal sense is to draw air into the lungs.

clue.text: Many following a little beast appear calculating

indicators.note: following means the many comes after the little beast

parts.note: a shrew is a tiny mouse-like mammal
D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number

explanation.surface: Lots of creatures trailing after a small animal look as if they are planning something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following' puts D (Roman 500, standing for 'many') after SHREW.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrewd person is astute and cunning, so scheming or calculating.

clue.text: Enhances a number among the laying birds

indicators.note: among places the number inside the birds

parts.note: hens are the birds that lay eggs on a farm
eight is a number

explanation.walkthrough: 'among' signals the container; 'laying birds' looks like a description but is the outer piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To heighten something is to intensify or increase it, so to make it greater.

clue.text: A European schoolboy will accept direction

indicators.note: will accept means the schoolboy takes the direction inside him

parts.note: an Etonian is a pupil of Eton College, the English boys' public school

explanation.surface: A pupil from abroad agrees to follow instructions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will accept' puts S inside ETONIAN: E-S-TONIAN. Eton is a famous English boarding school whose pupils are Etonians.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Estonia, a Baltic state, is a European.

clue.text: Repugnance shown by good man-a good man in decline

indicators.note: in places the run of saints inside the word for decline

parts.note: to die away is to decline or fade
ST, for saint, is the crossword shorthand for a good man
ST again, a saint being a good man

explanation.surface: A virtuous man is disgusted by another virtuous man going downhill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' signals the container: the saint, A and saint go inside the word for decline, after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Distaste is dislike or aversion, which is what repugnance means.

clue.text: Stayed in custody

explanation.definitionFit: To arrest is to stop or check progress, as a stay does; someone held by police has been arrested.

explanation.walkthrough: 'to be tidied up' rearranges the letters of A HUT IS.
explanation.definitionFit: A hiatus is a gap or pause in continuity, an interruption.

clue.text: Wine available in plastic containers

explanation.definitionFit: Asti is a sparkling white wine from Piedmont in Italy.

an ace is the one in a pack of cards
to rate is an old word for scold or reprove

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a learner driver displays an L plate. RATE meaning scold is archaic but common in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: To lacerate is to tear the flesh, so to cut or injure.

clue.text: A little of this will strengthen naturally red hair colouring

explanation.walkthrough: 'A little of' points to the run hidden in strengt-HEN NA-turally.
explanation.definitionFit: Henna is a reddish dye from a shrub, used to tint hair.

explanation.walkthrough: 'eccentric' signals the anagram. 'Revolting' means rebelling, not disgusting.
explanation.definitionFit: An insurgent is someone in revolt, a rebel against authority.

clue.text: At fault in backing cut-heartless cut

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: backing means the word for cut is read backwards

parts.note: to axe is to cut, as with jobs or budgets

indicators.note: heartless means its middle letter is removed

parts.note: the word cut itself is taken

explanation.surface: A complaint about a budget reduction that was reversed and then cut again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns AXE into EXA; 'heartless' takes the middle U from CUT to leave CT. IN + EXA + CT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inexact is wrong in detail, so mistaken or faulty.

clue.text: Soft with 19 across, being prejudiced

the craftsman answer at 19 across

explanation.definitionFit: A partisan view takes one side, so it is biased.

taken as written
